acceptance_predicates.description: A default install by an unprivileged user places the ASB executable at $HOME/.local/bin/asb.
Any equivalent ASB install command uses the same user-local default or explicitly documents a distinct, tested contract.
An explicit safe PREFIX remains supported for packaging and CI without writing to the user's default location.
Relative, empty, unsafe, or unrelated paths are rejected; no root access or writes outside the selected prefix are required.
Help and diagnostics explain PATH setup and the installed executable location for a fresh user.

definition_of_done: Signed+DCO implementation is independently reviewed and merged into protected ASB main.
Focused install-prefix tests and all applicable locked workspace gates pass on the exact reviewed head.
Post-merge evidence proves the default user-local path, explicit-prefix path, and no out-of-prefix writes.

inputs.description: Current ASB Makefile install target and prefix handling.
Any ASB CLI install path that shares or duplicates binary installation.

outputs.description: User-local default install with validated explicit prefix support.
Disposable HOME/prefix regression coverage and exact-head receipt.

gates.description: Default and explicit-prefix installs pass as an unprivileged disposable user.
Locked build, format, clippy, test, documentation, and dependency integrity gates pass.
Exact reviewed PR and protected-main post-merge workflows pass.
